construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.synthetic: Must be true; all supplied content is synthetic fixture data
input.claims: 1..100 objects: unique id, statement, evidence array
input.evidence: 0..500 entries per claim: document_id, exact source quote, stance (support/oppose/neutral), quality (low/medium/high), context
input.questions: 0..100 objects: unique id, question, unique claim_ids referencing existing claims
input.constraints: No unknown fields. Nonblank strings. IDs <=100 chars, context <=200, title <=1000, document text <=100000, other input strings <=10000. UTF-8 JSON files <=2000000 bytes; duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard constants rejected.

output.success: status=ok, synthetic=true, research_question, summary, findings, disagreements, unresolved_questions, limitations
output.finding: claim_id, statement, status, per-context counts and quality weights, exact attributed citations
output.error: One JSON object with status=error and error message; exit 2

shared_schema.validation: One shared validate(value, kind) boundary layer for input and success output, using common structural primitives; CLI errors share one error envelope.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single integrated Research stage: validated request -> source-linked evidence normalization -> context synthesis -> disagreement/gap reporting -> validated response. No independent downstream stages.

behavior.determinism: Claims, contexts, citations, source IDs and requested questions are sorted. No randomness, dates, model inference or external data.
behavior.evidence_synthesis: Groups explicitly supplied evidence by claim and exact context label; emits both attributed quotations and aggregate findings.
behavior.quality: Low/medium/high map to 1/2/3. Each source contributes at most its highest weight per stance and context. Duplicate identical citations retain the highest supplied quality. Weights never override contradictions.
behavior.disagreement: Support and opposition in the same context is contested, including internal contradictions within one document. Opposing directions only across contexts are context-dependent, not direct disagreements.
behavior.unresolved: Creates questions for contested, context-dependent and insufficient claims. All explicitly supplied follow-up questions remain open even when linked claims are supported.
behavior.safety_of_conclusions: Support is a description of caller-annotated evidence, not a truth claim. Neutral evidence cannot resolve a claim. Quotations must occur literally in the referenced document.

test_outcomes.cli: Passed: emitted one valid JSON object with status ok
coverage: Malformed JSON and UTF-8 and oversized inputs
